description: Historical dataset analysis and baseline model evaluation - establish data foundation and measure current 4-model system performance without optimization
steps: Create backend/scripts/historical_dataset_census.py to query database for total/finished matches, document exclusions, calculate sample sizes per team/competition
Create backend/app/prediction/dataset_validator.py with match eligibility filtering and sample size validation utilities
Create backend/app/prediction/baseline_evaluator.py for production pipeline evaluation using current 4-model ensemble with ReliabilityWeights
Create backend/scripts/evaluate_baseline_models.py to run baseline evaluation and output individual model + ensemble metrics in JSON format
Run baseline evaluation script and verify it produces structured metrics for all 4 operational models
acceptance_criteria: Historical dataset census script documents exact usability: total matches, finished matches, exclusion reasons with counts
Dataset validator correctly identifies eligible matches for walk-forward evaluation with proper sample size checks
Baseline evaluator measures individual model performance (Poisson, Dixon-Coles, Negative Binomial, Form Adjusted) with accuracy/Brier/log loss metrics
Baseline evaluation script produces JSON report with per-model and ensemble metrics using current production configuration
All baseline evaluation handles insufficient samples with explicit INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_SAMPLE reporting
verification: python backend/scripts/historical_dataset_census.py outputs detailed census with ~4,543 total, ~2,673 finished matches
python backend/scripts/evaluate_baseline_models.py completes successfully and generates baseline_metrics.json
Baseline metrics show 4/7 models operational status matching current production state
